notes: Eingebautes image_gen-Tool, kein CLI-Fallback. Drei Generierungsversuche, jeden visuell geprüft.
Szene: Drohung gegen den am Boden liegenden Jungen im zweiten Schlachtzug, anschließend Rückstoß durch Valentus. Junge und Effekte nicht eingezeichnet.
Finale Rohfassung entspricht Versuch 1. Raster und Figurenkontinuität sind hier besser als in Versuch 2 und 3. Keine Freigabe als fertiges Animationsasset.
Rohbild 1254 x 1254 RGBA mit echter Transparenz. Zielgröße bezeichnet die spätere Größe pro Frame; keine Pixelize-Verarbeitung oder Codeänderung vorgenommen.
Die Rohmaße sind nicht durch vier teilbar. Der Rasterzuschnitt benötigt explizite Prüfung. Große Posen benötigen das Format 48 x 64.

film_look.details: Breiter schwerer menschlicher Fußsoldat, unmaskiertes Gesicht, dunkle Kleidung, Kettenkragen, schwarz-weißer Wappenrock, große Axt. Wappenrock im gewählten Bild längs zweigeteilt statt geviertelt.

palette.details: Gedämpfte Stahl-, Kohle-, Leder- und gebrochen weiße Töne bei flachem Licht. Keine Neon- oder Magieeffekte.

grid_identity_directions.details: 16 Posen in 4 x 4 Anordnung, Westen in Zeilen 1/2 und Süden in Zeile 4 erkennbar. Gleiche Figur und ähnliche stehende Fußlinie. Sehr knappe Ränder an erhobener Axt und Flugpose. Vier Gehbilder vorhanden, aber Stride-/Passing-Paare unterscheiden sich zu wenig; flüssiger Zyklus nicht belegt. Kein technisch ganzzahliges Zellmaß.

prohibitions.details: Kein zweiter Mensch, kein gezeichneter Gegner, keine Kulisse, Burg, Runen, Monster, erfundenen Wappenzeichen, Neon, HUD, Text, Wasserzeichen oder Druckwelleneffekte.

pixel_style.details: Dunkle Konturen und sichtbare Pixelstruktur, realistische erwachsene Proportionen. Schattierung und Kettenstruktur feiner als die angestrebten sparsamen einheitlichen Pixelcluster; erhöhte Kameraperspektive nur schwach.

transparency.details: RGBA, Alpha von 0 bis 255, transparente Ecken; kein aufgemaltes Schachbrett.

attempts.details: Beste gleichmäßige 4-x-4-Anordnung und konsistente Waffenführung. Randabstand teils nur wenige Rohpixel, halbierter Wappenrock, ähnliche Gehposen, zu feine Schattierung.
Axt mit mehr Kopfraum, aber stehende Figuren überschreiten horizontale Zellgrenzen. Wappenrock weiterhin nicht geviertelt; Gehposen kaum verbessert.

Geviertelter Wappenrock und gröbere Darstellung verbessert. Stehende Figuren überschreiten Zellgrenzen, erhobene Axt sehr dicht am oberen Rand, Waffe wechselt im Südzyklus die Hand. Figurenproportionen weniger passend.

known_defects: Sehr knapper Abstand zwischen Waffen und Zellrändern.
1254 x 1254 ist nicht durch vier teilbar.
Pixelraster und Kamera entsprechen der Referenz nur teilweise.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art animation spritesheet for Selantis RPG prologue, spr-ds-axe.png.

Create ONE square transparent PNG spritesheet, exactly FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, 16 individual animation frames, uniform equal-sized cells. Suggested raw canvas 1536x1536, each cell 384x384; no visible grid or labels. All artwork must remain inside its respective cell with ample transparent gutters. Intended downstream large-pose target is 48x64 pixels per frame, so silhouettes must read at small scale.

Reference images in conversation: IMAGE 1 is ONLY pixel-art rendering/camera style reference: restrained detailed pixel clusters, dark outlines, muted natural colors, fixed slightly elevated three-quarter overhead RPG view, adult realistic 6–7 head proportions. IMAGE 2 is costume and ordinary human soldier reference: dark trousers/boots, black-and-white fabric surcoat over dark clothing, ordinary unmasked human face. IMAGE 3 is costume/heraldic quartering reference: black-and-white quartered fabric, do not invent an emblem, do not draw the banners or background.

Subject SAME broad, heavy-built adult human Dunkelschatten axe infantryman in ALL 16 cells, consistent face, short dark hair, uncovered face (no mask), broad shoulders, dark chainmail coif framing but not concealing face, dark charcoal underclothes, black and dirty off-white QUARTERED knee-length surcoat, dark leather belt, dark trousers and boots. Huge practical two-handed iron battleaxe with long brown wooden shaft and broad steel axe head. No decorative fantasy armor, no horned helmet, no invented insignia. Menacing through posture and heavy human body rather than supernatural appearance. Restrained steel-grey #59616A, charcoal #34383D, muddy olive #5D6043, aged white, dark leather, natural muted skin, flat dim battle light. No magic blue or orange emission.

Narrative: This is the axe fighter about to deliver a lethal overhead chop to a fallen young soldier in the fever-dream battle, then hurled away by Valentus's pressure wave. Draw ONLY the axe fighter and his axe, NEVER the fallen opponent, another person, scenery, blood, ground, shadows cast onto the background, particles, pressure waves, motion lines, glowing runes, HUD, text or watermark.

Exact row-major frame choreography, one figure per cell:
ROW 1 WEST FACING (face, nose, chest orientation directed toward LEFT; threatening an implied opponent on ground to left). Cell 1: grounded idle, heavy wide planted stance, two hands holding axe low ready. Cell 2: very unmistakable overhead threat/telegraph, BOTH arms raised, large axe held HIGH ABOVE HIS HEAD, blade entirely above head, poised to chop downward left. Cell 3: powerful downward axe chop toward lower-left, deep torso lean, axe cutting low but no effects. Cell 4: chop follow-through, axe head low near left boot, shoulders pitched forward.
ROW 2 WEST FACING WALK CYCLE FOUR frames: left foot forward, passing stance, right foot forward, opposite passing stance. Axe held consistently low in both hands. Face LEFT in all four. Same scale and baseline as row1.
ROW 3 KNOCKBACK SEQUENCE: cell1 lift-off, feet lifted, chest recoils backward, axes and hands coherent; cell2 airborne thrown toward RIGHT, torso diagonal nearly horizontal, boots toward left and head toward right, axe held with one hand; cell3 impact on back/right shoulder, legs lifted momentarily, axe alongside body; cell4 prone on back after landing, horizontal inert body, boots toward left and head toward right, axe lies immediately alongside within same cell. These are distinct physical poses, not walks, no visual effect. Keep adult body size unchanged when rotated. No second character.
ROW 4 SOUTH FACING WALK CYCLE FOUR frames, walking toward camera/bottom: left foot forward, passing, right foot forward, opposite passing. Face and surcoat front clearly visible in ALL four cells. Axe carried lowered to his side. Same identity, adult proportions and body scale.

Composition: perfectly regular 4x4 atlas. Equal cell centers and stable grounded foot baseline in rows 1,2,4; row3 airborne/grounded progression naturally varies vertically but remains contained. Entire raised axe and horizontal prone bodies fully visible, no overlap between cells, no cut-off weapons. Straight pixel steps and crisp clustered shading, uniform pixel size, NO phototextures, NO soft gradients, NO bloom, NO blurry edges, NO chibi heads, NO smooth painted illustration. True transparent alpha background.

EDIT this spritesheet into a corrected production pixel-art atlas. Preserve exactly 4 columns x4 rows, all 16 existing poses, SAME broad heavy human unmasked axe fighter identity, west-facing top two rows, lift-off/airborne/impact/prone third row, south walking fourth row, large iron axe and dark costume. Preserve transparent background. No other person, no effects, no text.

REQUIRED CORRECTIONS:
1) EXACT square canvas 1024x1024 pixels; each equal grid cell 256x256. No grid lines. At least 20 pixels TRANSPARENT MARGIN INSIDE EACH CELL on ALL FOUR sides of the entire silhouette, including axe and prone feet. Reduce all figures uniformly enough that the high overhead axe in row1 col2 is FULLY IN FRAME with top margin and the axe in row3 col1 is fully inside its cell with left margin. Stable foot baseline y=232 inside each grounded cell. Same body scale all16 frames, including rotated prone figure. Max entire pose width 216 pixels, max entire pose height 216 pixels. 
2) Black-white QUARTERED surcoat: upper-left dark black, upper-right aged white, lower-left aged white, lower-right dark black, divided at belt horizontally. FOUR contrasting quadrants, not two continuous longitudinal bands. Match left faction cloth in attached movie heraldry reference. NO invented emblem.
3) Replace fine realistic stippling and smooth shading with genuinely crisp hand-pixeled videogame sprite rendering: large consistent pixel clusters as if logical 64x64 cell pixels enlarged x4 with nearest neighbor, maximum 20 flat muted color shades, hard stepped shapes, dark outlines, sparse details, NO smooth antialiasing, NO fine phototextured chainmail, NO soft gradients. Use the first attached RPG screenshot for pixel art treatment and fixed lightly elevated three-quarter overhead camera. Adult 6–7 head proportions, NOT chibi. Heavy broad torso.
4) West walk four frames must visibly alternate lead legs and have two distinct passing frames, not repeat a single pose. South walk same. Preserve extremely clear overhead axe telegraph and convincing 4-pose knockback progression without visual effects.
Palette muted steel #59616A, charcoal #34383D, dirty off-white, muddy olive #5D6043, muted skin and dark brown wooden shaft. Flat dim battle lighting. True transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Make a TRUE LOW RESOLUTION PIXEL ART sprite animation atlas for Selantis RPG spr-ds-axe. Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 sprites, perfect equal grid, transparent alpha background, NO labels, NO gridlines, NO ground or shadows. Portrait canvas aspect 3:4, intended final atlas 192x256, cells48x64. Render enlarged nearest-neighbor pixels, hard square stair-step edges and chunky discrete flat-color clusters, maximum 24 colors. NOT smooth game concept illustration. Each visible logical pixel SAME SIZE throughout. Match the pixel rendering of the FIRST ATTACHED forest RPG reference and its mildly elevated 3/4 overhead camera; ignore its scenery/UI. No background. Crisp readable at 48x64, adult realistic 6–7 head proportions. Huge overhead axe entirely inside cell with generous top gutter; every horizontal flying figure inside cell with generous side gutters. Same body size and identity in ALL cells; stable grounded feet baseline.

Single broad heavy muscular HUMAN Dunkelschatten infantryman. Unmasked ordinary human face, short dark hair, grey chainmail collar, dark charcoal sleeves and trousers, dark boots, belt. BLACK-WHITE QUARTERED surcoat specifically in CHECKERBOARD arrangement: UPPER LEFT BLACK / UPPER RIGHT OFF-WHITE; BELOW BELT LOWER LEFT OFF-WHITE / LOWER RIGHT BLACK. IMPORTANT COLOR SWAP BELOW BELT, no continuous white stripe! NO emblem. Film references attached give ordinary soldier clothing and black-white heraldic quartering. Big practical axe, wide steel-grey iron blade, dark brown wooden long shaft. No ornate fantasy armor, no monster, no magic. Muted #59616A steel #34383D charcoal #5D6043 muddy olive, dirty off-white and muted skin. Dim flat battlefield light.

Tell the actual prologue moment: enemy threatening a fallen young soldier with overhead axe then thrown away by Valentus. DRAW ONLY AXEMAN, NEVER the boy, blood, pressure wave, particles, motion streaks or any effects.

Exact row-major order:
Row1 ALL WEST, nose points LEFT, same lightly overhead camera: 1 idle planted holding heavy axe; 2 overhead menace TWO HANDS holding axe HIGH ABOVE HEAD, threat pose; 3 violent downward chop to low LEFT; 4 deep leaned followthrough with axe at lower LEFT.
Row2 ALL WEST walk 4 clearly DISTINCT poses carrying axe low: 1 LEFT leg stretched forward LEFT and RIGHT leg back; 2 left leg supporting torso, right knee passing forward; 3 RIGHT leg stretched forward LEFT and LEFT leg back; 4 right leg supporting torso, left knee passing forward. Two visibly opposite stride poses and two distinct passing poses.
Row3 four knockback frames thrown RIGHT: 1 lifting off backwards, boots leave ground, torso recoils; 2 airborne horizontal with feet LEFT and head RIGHT, axe in hand; 3 impact back/right shoulder, legs thrown up, axe beside body; 4 motionless horizontal prone on back, feet LEFT head RIGHT, axe lying beside. Adult body size preserved by rotation. NO effects.
Row4 SOUTH facing camera/bottom walk 4 clearly distinct poses, axe down by side: 1 left leg forward, right back; 2 right knee passing; 3 right leg forward, left back; 4 left knee passing. Front face and checkerboard surcoat visible.
Each sprite's whole body and whole axe fully enclosed with transparent gutters within own cell, no cropping and no neighboring overlap. No text, watermark, rune, banner, scenery, neon, bloom, gradients, smooth painted shading, photorealistic textures, tiny stippling, chibi.
